name: Beorn
text:
Sentinel. Cannot have attachments. Immune to player card effects.
Beorn does not exhaust to defend.

name: Bilbo Baggins
text: Cannot gain resources from player card effects. The first player gains control of Bilbo Baggins and can trigger Action and Response effects on cards in the boons area. Action: Spend 1 [baggins] resource. Then, each player may draw 1 card. If Bilbo Baggins leaves play, the players lose the game.

name: Lucky Number
text: Action: Add Lucky Number to the victory display to choose a character controlled by each player. Give those characters +2 [willpower], +2 [attack], and +2 [defense] until the end of the round.
flavor: “Just let any one say I chose the wrong man or the wrong house, and you can stop at thirteen and have all the bad luck you like, or go back to digging coal.” —Gandalf, The Hobbit

name: No Bag Went Over Me
text: Action: Add No Bag Went Over Me to the victory display to reduce each player’s threat by 3.
flavor: Bilbo had just enough wits left, when Bert dropped him on the ground, to scramble out of the way of their feet… —The Hobbit

name: Sting
text: Action: Add Sting to the victory display. Each player may choose an enemy in play and deal 2 damage to it.
flavor: “These look like good blades… They were not made by any troll, nor by any smith among men in these parts and days…” —Gandalf, The Hobbit

name: Bilbo's Magic Ring
text: Bilbo’s Magic Ring enters play with 1[pp] resources on it. Response: Discard 1 resource token from Bilbo’s Magic Ring to cancel up to 3 damage just dealt to Bilbo Baggins.
flavor: …suddenly his hand met what felt like a tiny ring of cold metal lying on the floor of the tunnel. —The Hobbit

name: He that Walks Unseen
text: Action: Add He that Walks Unseen to the victory display to choose a non-unique enemy engaged with a player. That enemy cannot attack that player this phase. If there are 3 or more players, choose up to 2 non-unique enemies instead (they can be engaged with different players).
flavor: And there was the ring still, in his left pocket, and it slipped on his finger. The goblins stopped short. They could not see a sign of him. He had vanished. —The Hobbit

name: Guest of Eagles
text: Action: If the main quest is The Battle of the Five Armies, add Guest of Eagles to the victory display to reveal the set-aside Great Eagles. Shuffle the encounter deck.
flavor: Eagles are not kindly birds… But the ancient race of the northern mountains were the greatest of all birds; they were proud and strong and noble-hearted. —The Hobbit

name: Friend of Bears
text: Action: If the main quest is The Battle of the Five Armies, add Friend of Bears to the victory display to reveal the set-aside Beorn or Giant-sized Wrath. If there are 3 or more players, you may reveal both.
flavor: “Mr. Baggins’ eyes are sharper than yours, if you have not seen each night after dark a great bear going along with us or sitting far off in the moon watching our camps.” —Gandalf, The Hobbit

name: The Stinging Fly
text: Action: Add The Stinging Fly to the victory display. Each player may ready a character they control.
flavor: He felt a different person, and much fiercer and bolder in spite of an empty stomach, as he wiped his sword on the grass and put it back into its sheath. —The Hobbit

name: The Web-cutter
text: Action: Add The Web-cutter to the victory display. Each player may return up to 5 cards from their discard pile to their deck. Each player may search their deck for a card, add it to their hand, and shuffle their deck.
flavor: He darted backwards and forwards, slashing at spider-threads, hacking at their legs, and stabbing at their fat bodies if they came too near. —The Hobbit

name: Drowner of Friends
text: Action: Add Drowner of Friends to the victory display. Each player may put an ally from their discard pile into play.
flavor: “I do hope I put the lids on tight enough!” —Bilbo Baggins, The Hobbit

name: Barrel-rider
text: Action: If the main quest is The Battle of the Five Armies, add Barrel-rider to the victory display to reveal the set-aside Men of the Lake.
flavor: …it was like trying to ride, without bridle or stirrups, a round-bellied pony that was always thinking of rolling on the grass. —The Hobbit

name: Thror's Golden Cup
text: Action: Add Thror’s Golden Cup to the victory display. Each player adds 2 resources to the pool of a hero they control.
flavor: “I suppose you got a fair price for that cup last night?” —Smaug, The Hobbit

name: The Arkenstone
text: Action: If the main quest is The Battle of the Five Armies, add The Arkenstone to the victory display to reveal the set-aside Dwarves of Dáin or Elves of Mirkwood. If there are 3 or more players, you may reveal both.
flavor: “…it shone like silver in the firelight, like water in the sun, like snow under the stars, like rain upon the Moon!” —Thorin Oakenshield, The Hobbit

name: Without a Hat
text: Players cannot play attachments. Forced: At the end of the first round, remove Without a Hat from the game.
flavor: “I’m awfully sorry,” said Bilbo, “but I have come without my hat, and I have left my pocket-handkerchief behind, and I haven’t got any money.” —The Hobbit

name: Two by Two
text: Each player cannot play or put into play more than 2 cards during each planning phase.
flavor: “I was coming over the mountains with a friend or two…” —Gandalf, The Hobbit

name: Longing for Home
text: Forced: After Longing for Home enters your hand or discard pile, attach it to the hero you control with the highest [willpower]. While attached to a hero, counts as a Condition attachment with the text: “Attached hero gets –2 [willpower]. Forced: After a Title boon is earned, shuffle Longing for Home into your deck.”

name: Beyond the Original Bargain
text:
If you choose Beyond the Original Bargain as your contract, you can choose 2 additional contracts for this game. Each contract you choose must be different.
Your starting threat is increased by 4.
flavor: “I have got you out of two messes already…” —Bilbo Baggins, The Hobbit

name: Thorin's Company
text: This contract cannot be chosen unless you are playing a scenario featuring [baggins] Bilbo Baggins. Setup: Search the top 13 cards of your deck, choose 2 allies among those cards and put them into play under your control. The total printed cost of cards you put into play in this way cannot exceed 6. Shuffle the remaining cards into your deck.

name: Master Burglar
text: Limit 1 per deck. Attach to Bilbo Baggins. He gets +2 [willpower] and –1 threat cost. If you have won The Hobbit ALeP community scenario with 10 or more boons in play, you may attach this card from your collection to an eligible printed hero when you put your starting heroes into play.
